reference: Unit depth, unequal widths (0.25,0.75) m and row heights (0.25,0.5) m. k=(1,3), contact resistance 0.125, capacity=(2,4), H=(0.5,2) in SI units. Rightward flux -1 W/m², starting center temperatures (0.125,0.5) K. Both walls rise at 1 K/s until 0.125 s and cool at 2 K/s until 0.5 s. Source = capacity*dT/dt + H*T. Compare step-integrated source, sink, interface flux, final temperature and energy residual directly. CN uses exact piecewise-linear temperature integral; Rannacher uses its analytical endpoint-quadrature value. Separate one-cell test verifies monotone theta and a static heater.
